dedupe_keys.name: baci international trade database at the product level

description: BACI provides bilateral trade flows for 200 countries at the product level, about 5,000 products in the six-digit Harmonized System nomenclature. It is produced by CEPII, the French research centre in international economics, from the United Nations Statistical Division's Comtrade data. Because countries report both imports and exports, the raw data contain two values for each flow that rarely match, since imports are valued CIF and exports FOB and reporting errors occur; BACI estimates and removes CIF costs and weights each reporter by its reliability to give a single reconciled flow. Data are free downloads under the Etalab 2.0 open licence, with the methodology documented in Gaulier and Zignago (2010), CEPII Working Paper 2010-23; the contact person is Pierre Cotterlaz. Caveats: values are annual, mirror estimates cannot recover trade that neither partner reports, and the product classification follows HS revisions. For simulation it provides the product-level trade network for supply-chain disruption, cross-border dependency and resilience analyses of industrial inputs such as critical minerals, chemicals and food. Related catalogue records include EXIOBASE, Eora2 and the World Input-Output Database.
